question: Could you analyze the relationship between each complaint type and daily temperature in New York City, specifically using temperature data from LaGuardia (STN=725030) and JFK (STN=744860) airports for the 10 years starting in 2008, and then determine, for each complaint type that has more than 5000 total occurrences and shows a strong correlation (absolute value > 0.5) with temperature, the total number of complaints, the total number of days with valid temperature records, and the Pearson correlation coefficients (rounded to four decimals) between temperature and both the daily complaint count as well as the daily percentage of total complaints, excluding any days with missing or invalid temperature data (such as 9999.9)?

WITH temp_data AS (
  SELECT CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE) as date, temp, stn
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2008` WHERE stn IN ('725030', '744860') AND temp != 9999.9
  UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE), temp, stn FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2009` WHERE stn IN ('725030', '744860') AND temp != 9999.9
  UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE), temp, stn FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2010` WHERE stn IN ('725030', '744860') AND temp != 9999.9
  UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE), temp, stn FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2011` WHERE stn IN ('725030', '744860') AND temp != 9999.9
  UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE), temp, stn FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2012` WHERE stn IN ('725030', '744860') AND temp != 9999.9
  UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE), temp, stn FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2013` WHERE stn IN ('725030', '744860') AND temp != 9999.9
  UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE), temp, stn FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2014` WHERE stn IN ('725030', '744860') AND temp != 9999.9
  UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE), temp, stn FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2015` WHERE stn IN ('725030', '744860') AND temp != 9999.9
  UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE), temp, stn FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2016` WHERE stn IN ('725030', '744860') AND temp != 9999.9
  UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE), temp, stn FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2017` WHERE stn IN ('725030', '744860') AND temp != 9999.9
),
avg_temp AS (
  SELECT date, AVG(temp) as avg_temp
  FROM temp_data
  GROUP BY date
),
daily_complaints AS (
  SELECT DATE(created_date) as date, complaint_type, COUNT(*) as complaint_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE DATE(created_date) BETWEEN '2008-01-01' AND '2017-12-31'
  GROUP BY DATE(created_date), complaint_type
),
daily_totals AS (
  SELECT DATE(created_date) as date, COUNT(*) as total_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE DATE(created_date) BETWEEN '2008-01-01' AND '2017-12-31'
  GROUP BY DATE(created_date)
),
complaint_totals AS (
  SELECT complaint_type, SUM(complaint_count) as total_complaints
  FROM daily_complaints
  GROUP BY complaint_type
  HAVING SUM(complaint_count) > 5000
),
joined AS (
  SELECT dc.complaint_type, avt.avg_temp, dc.complaint_count, 
         SAFE_DIVIDE(dc.complaint_count, dt.total_count) * 100 as pct_complaints,
         ct.total_complaints
  FROM daily_complaints dc
  JOIN avg_temp avt ON dc.date = avt.date
  JOIN daily_totals dt ON dc.date = dt.date
  JOIN complaint_totals ct ON dc.complaint_type = ct.complaint_type
),
corr AS (
  SELECT complaint_type,
         total_complaints,
         COUNT(*) as num_days_with_temp,
         ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(
           COUNT(*) * SUM(avg_temp * complaint_count) - SUM(avg_temp) * SUM(complaint_count),
           SQRT((COUNT(*) * SUM(POWER(avg_temp, 2)) - POWER(SUM(avg_temp), 2)) * 
                (COUNT(*) * SUM(POWER(complaint_count, 2)) - POWER(SUM(complaint_count), 2)))
         ), 4) as corr_temp_count,
         ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(
           COUNT(*) * SUM(avg_temp * pct_complaints) - SUM(avg_temp) * SUM(pct_complaints),
           SQRT((COUNT(*) * SUM(POWER(avg_temp, 2)) - POWER(SUM(avg_temp), 2)) * 
                (COUNT(*) * SUM(POWER(pct_complaints, 2)) - POWER(SUM(pct_complaints), 2)))
         ), 4) as corr_temp_pct
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY complaint_type, total_complaints
)
SELECT complaint_type, total_complaints, num_days_with_temp, corr_temp_count, corr_temp_pct
FROM corr
WHERE ABS(corr_temp_count) > 0.5 OR ABS(corr_temp_pct) > 0.5
ORDER BY complaint_type
